title: feature: support horizontal-layout for changes and details:
description:
I implemented it, and post the patch here:
https://code.launchpad.net/~yurenchen/ubuntu/+source/update-manager/+git/update-manager/+ref/layout_horizon

in this patch:
- add a `layout-horizon` bool setting in gschema.xml
- check `layout-horizon` setting and apply to window layout at window init

so that, user can change layout via `gsettings` or `dconf`

```
$ gsettings set com.ubuntu.update-manager layout-horizon false
$ gsettings set com.ubuntu.update-manager layout-horizon true
$ gsettings get com.ubuntu.update-manager layout-horizon
true
commit_message:
feature: support horizontal-layout for changes and details:
  add `layout-horizon` bool setting, 
  and apply to layout at window init

https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/update-manager/+bug/2019249
diff:
diff --git a/UpdateManager/UpdatesAvailable.py b/UpdateManager/UpdatesAvailable.py
index ffdb91c..f14c14f 100644
--- a/UpdateManager/UpdatesAvailable.py
+++ b/UpdateManager/UpdatesAvailable.py
@@ -366,6 +366,10 @@ class UpdatesAvailable(InternalDialog):
             "summary-before-name"
         )
 
+        # layout_horizon
+        if self.settings.get_boolean("layout-horizon"):
+            self.paned.set_orientation(Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL)
+
         # expander
         self.expander_details.set_expanded(
             self.settings.get_boolean("show-details")
diff --git a/data/com.ubuntu.update-manager.gschema.xml.in b/data/com.ubuntu.update-manager.gschema.xml.in
index 40c618b..f323f6b 100644
--- a/data/com.ubuntu.update-manager.gschema.xml.in
+++ b/data/com.ubuntu.update-manager.gschema.xml.in
@@ -1,5 +1,10 @@
 <schemalist>
   <schema id="com.ubuntu.update-manager" path="/apps/update-manager/">
+    <key name="layout-horizon" type="b">
+      <default>false</default>
+      <summary>Show layout as horizontal</summary>
+      <description>show list and detail in horizontal layout</description>
+    </key>
     <key name="show-details" type="b">
       <default>false</default>
       <summary>Show details of an update</summary>
